start.name: {name}
start.text: *Outside the school gates in April. Crushed petals cling to the pavement here and there. The creases in my new uniform still run across the elbows, and my transfer papers lie pressed flat inside my bag.*

start_3.name: {name}
start_3.text: *My phone buzzes in my pocket. It's the group chat from my old school. A familiar name is on the screen. I stare at it for a moment, then put the phone away.*

gate_1.name: {name}
gate_1.text: *An unfamiliar school gate. Mine is the only uniform with sharp creases still pressed into it. Beside the gate, a girl with long black hair adjusts her glasses and checks the time. When I stop, she looks up.*

seoyeon_meet_2.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_2.text: *She confirms {name}'s name once more and checks it off on her clipboard. Then she studies {name} for another moment over her glasses.*

seoyeon_meet_4.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_4.text: I'm the student council president. Showing transfer students around is my job.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Come on. I'll have this done in fifteen minutes.

seoyeon_meet_6.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_6.text: The council president, in person? I'm flattered.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_7.text: I'll be the judge of that.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_8.text: *A laugh slips out before I can stop it. Seoyeon is already walking through the gate.*

seoyeon_choice.name: {name}
choices: Wait — you didn't come all the way out here just for me, did you?
So what's the tour gonna cost me?
It's fine, I'll just figure it out myself.

choice_dismiss_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_1.text: *She stops and turns only her head toward {name}.*

choice_dismiss_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_2.text: Yeah? Then at least remember the room number. Class 3-2, far end on the right.

choice_dismiss_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_3.text: *She turns away without a word. Without even a gesture, she walks into the school grounds.*

choice_flirt_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_1.text: *She stops and looks back. Her eyes curve slightly behind her glasses.*

choice_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_2.text: Wow. Not even shy on day one. I'll remember your name, no problem.

choice_flirt_4.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_4.text: Looks like you still haven't read the room. I don't hate it.

choice_flirt_6.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_6.text: Honor or disaster — jury's still out.

choice_flirt_7.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_7.text: *She walks on ahead and glances back once. When {name}'s footsteps draw closer, she keeps the same pace.*

choice_joke_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_1.text: Free. — But it'll come with interest later.

choice_joke_2.name: {name}
choice_joke_2.text: You're a scary student council president.

choice_joke_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_3.text: At least it won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: Seoyeon
hallway_1.text: *She leads the way down the hall. Students greet her first as they pass, and Seoyeon acknowledges each one with a light nod.*

hallway_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_3.text: Senior building's here, library's over there. Snack bar's in the basement.

hallway_4.name: Seoyeon
hallway_4.text: *She pulls out a key from her pocket and gives it a little shake.*

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: What, you got a secret hideout up there?

hallway_6_b.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_b.text: *The key ring goes still in her hand.* ...Sharp.

hallway_6_c.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_c.text: *Instead of answering, she slips the key back into her pocket.*

hallway_7.name: Seoyeon
hallway_7.text: Oh, lunch. You don't know where the cafeteria is, right? Come with me.

hallway_8.name: {name}
hallway_8.text: *Seoyeon stops outside a classroom and points to the sign beside the door.*

hallway_10.name: Seoyeon
hallway_10.text: Here it is. Go on in.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: You showing me around at lunch too?

hallway_13.name: Seoyeon
hallway_13.text: *She turns and gives a light wave. She doesn't look back.*

hallway_13_b.name: {name}
hallway_13_b.text: *Her stride never falters, all the way to the end of the hall.*

classroom_1.name: {name}
classroom_1.text: *I open the classroom door. Every eye turns toward me.*

classroom_2_b.name: {name}
classroom_2_b.text: *The homeroom teacher stands at the front of the room, attendance book in hand. She's in her late twenties, with a few buttons of her cardigan undone.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Alright, everyone. We've got a transfer student joining us today. Want to introduce yourself?

classroom_3_b.name: {name}
classroom_3_b.text: I'm {name}. Nice to meet you all. *The teacher nods.*

classroom_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_5_b.text: ...Right. {name}. I'll remember that. *Quietly, almost to herself* I make it a point to memorize names on the first try.

classroom_5_c.name: {name}
classroom_5_c.text: *The teacher's mutter disappears under the classroom noise. A whistle sounds from one side of the room.*

classroom_dain_1.name: Dain
classroom_dain_1.text: Oh, a transfer student! A new face in our class!

classroom_dain_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_2.text: *Short brown hair and a volleyball uniform. She half rises from her seat and waves. The girl beside her tugs at her sleeve, but it's already too late.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: Dain, inside voice... And stop wearing your jersey to class.

classroom_dain_4.name: Dain
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw c'mon, teach, it's the comfiest thing I own! Anyway — welcome, new kid!

classroom_dain_5.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5.text: *Laughter breaks out around the room. Dain waves even higher.*

classroom_dain_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_b.text: *The homeroom teacher lets out a small sigh. She taps the corner of the attendance book and looks for the next name without even glancing at Dain.*

classroom_dain_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_c.text: ...Save some energy. First period hasn't even started yet.

classroom_dain_5_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_d.text: *The teacher turns the page in her attendance book.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_1.text: *I look over. A girl at the very back by the window rests her chin on one hand and stares outside. Even while my name goes up on the board, all she does is turn a page.*

classroom_yuna_2.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_2.text: *Silver-white hair. Red eyes. Tattoos along her arms. The girl in the back corner keeps her chin propped on one hand and looks only out the window. The desks around her are conspicuously empty.*

classroom_yuna_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_4.text: *Someone in the front row whispers, '...Don't talk to her. She's scary.' Yuna turns a page.*

classroom_seat_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_seat_1.text: *The homeroom teacher points to an empty seat.*

classroom_seat_2.name: {name}
classroom_seat_2.text: *The seat next to Dain. Before I could even sit down, Dain half-turned toward my desk.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: {name}
classroom_minsu_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when the guy in front of me turns around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, new kid. Welcome. — Word of warning, though.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *The name tag on the desk in front of me reads 'Minsu.' He has the look of someone who's already been through all this before.*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: *The moment I sit down, Dain leans over. The gap between our desks vanishes at once.*

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: Just because. I need someone to practice receives with after school. There's nobody to serve for me.

classroom_dain_talk_6.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_6.text: So I'm a ball machine now?

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: Still, you've got to be better than a ball machine. Probably!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: *After 'probably,' Dain's eyes drift toward the ball machine. A basket full of balls waits at the far end of the court.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *A folded note slides onto my desk. When I look back, the silver-haired girl by the window is still looking outside. The handwriting is neat.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *'Got stuck with a noisy seat. — Yuna' Lavender ink. A small crease at the corner of the note.*

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *I look toward Yuna. Her gaze is still fixed outside, but one hand rests below the desk, right where the note came from.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *Class starts. Yuna is looking out the window again. Dain is already chatting with the person next to her.*
